newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end mostly down in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end mostly down in thin trade.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mostly lower in lacklustre trade on Monday, as the yen's recovery against the dollar pressured the market, traders said.
Spot August ended up 0.5 yen from the previous close at 100. Other prices ranged from 0.4 yen to 1.7 yen lower, with benchmark January off 1.7 yen at 115.3 yen.

"Most market players retreated to the sidelines amid uncertainty over near-term direction in the currency market," one commodity broker said. "With few positive factors in sight, prices remained vulnerable to downside risk," the broker said. --Tokyo Commodity Desk, +81-3-3432-7431
